cameraInstructions: Film from the side with the back, hips, knees, ankles, and wall visible.

metrics.targetText: Keep the upper body upright and supported by the wall.
metrics.hint_good: Your upper body stayed upright against the wall.
metrics.hint_high: Your body leaned away from the wall. Press the back gently into the wall.

metrics.targetText: Place the feet so the knees stay comfortably over the ankles.
metrics.hint_good: Your feet supported a balanced knee position.
metrics.hint_low: The knees stayed too far behind the ankles. Move the feet slightly closer if comfortable.
metrics.hint_high: The knees moved too far forward. Move the feet slightly farther from the wall.

metrics.hint_good: You reached a strong wall sit depth.
metrics.hint_low: The wall sit was very deep. Slide up slightly and keep control.
metrics.hint_high: The wall sit was shallow. Slide down a little until the knees are closer to 90 degrees.

metrics.targetText: Keep the knees at a steady angle.
metrics.hint_good: Your wall sit depth stayed steady.
metrics.hint_high: Your body slid up and down. Set the feet and keep one steady depth.
